note: Get-by challenges — strategic competence. A real communicative goal you accomplish with the words you already know, not the 'perfect' word. Success is being understood. Models use only early, high-frequency vocabulary; the AI grades against the learner's actual taught set.

challenges.goal: Tell the waiter you don't eat meat — no fancy word needed.
You didn't catch the price. Ask them to repeat it clearly.
challenges.hint: Say you don't understand, then ask how much.

challenges.goal: You feel sick and need a doctor. Make that understood.
They're speaking too fast. Ask them to slow down and say it again.
You want a coffee with no milk, but blank on the word for 'milk'. Get the idea across.
challenges.hint: Name what you want and wave off the rest.
challenges.model: un café, sin leche, por favor
